void-black.$description: Void Black — Page background, card surfaces, overlay scrims — the entire canvas

graphite-hairline.$description: Graphite Hairline — 1px borders on cards, inputs, buttons, code blocks, dividers — defines every layer separation

white.$description: White — Primary headings, hero text, button labels, icon fills on dark surfaces

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Body text, secondary headings, stroke outlines on icons — the primary reading color

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Muted body text, badge labels, icon strokes — third-tier text and metadata

smoke-gray.$description: Smoke Gray — Link color, inactive button text, supporting captions — fourth-tier text

iron.$description: Iron — Subtle decorative strokes, disabled states, low-emphasis borders

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Inline code text, muted labels — text that should disappear into the surface

iris-violet.$description: Iris Violet — Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases; Diagonal violet-to-magenta gradient on icon containers and brand badges

iris-violet-glow.$description: Iris Violet Glow — Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

sky-blue.$description: Sky Blue — Blue text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases

pulse-green.$description: Pulse Green — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

alarm-red.$description: Alarm Red — Red text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

crimson.$description: Crimson — Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

amber.$description: Amber — Yellow text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

amber-glow.$description: Amber Glow — Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

surface-gradient.$description: Surface Gradient — Subtle card-to-canvas surface lift — used in edge fades and elevated panels

inter.$description: Body copy, UI labels, navigation, buttons, links. The workhorse — appears 1280 times across every non-code surface.

domaine.$description: Hero display type — weight 400 at 96px with -0.01em tracking creates an editorial, almost-printed feel. Only used twice on the entire page for the largest hero statement.

abc-favorit.$description: Section headlines and sub-headlines. The 56px weight-400 with -0.05em tracking is the signature — extreme negative tracking on a geometric sans creates a compressed, confident display feel that contrasts the editorial Domaine hero.

commit-mono.$description: Code blocks, inline code, terminal-style badges, API labels. Monospaced presence is the developer's identity signal — appears 814 times, rivaling Inter.

helvetica.$description: Helvetica — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

apple-system.$description: -apple-system — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
